ei.title: Life and Legacy of Lee Kuan Yew
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Lee Kuan Yew, Singapore's first prime minister, was born on September 16, 1923, and is of third-generation ethnic Chinese descent. He excelled in the Senior Cambridge examinations in 1940, earning the John Anderson Scholarship to attend Raffles College. During the prize-awarding ceremony, he met his future wife, Kwa Geok Choo, the only girl in the school. The onset of World War II in Asia disrupted Raffles College, which was converted into a medical facility in 1941. After the war, Lee chose not to return to Raffles College and pursued higher education in the United Kingdom. Initially, he enrolled at the London School of Economics but eventually studied law at Cambridge University. Lee Kuan Yew served as prime minister for 31 years, from 1959 to 1990. While his government restricted freedoms and maintained strict control over power, he also built excellent public housing, transforming Singapore into one of Asia's wealthiest countries.

questions.passage: Lee Kuan Yew, Singapore's first prime minister, was born on September 16, 1923, and is of third-generation ethnic Chinese descent. He excelled in the Senior Cambridge examinations in 1940, earning the John Anderson Scholarship to attend Raffles College. During the prize-awarding ceremony, he met his future wife, Kwa Geok Choo, the only girl in the school. The onset of World War II in Asia disrupted Raffles College, which was converted into a medical facility in 1941. After the war, Lee chose not to return to Raffles College and pursued __________ in the United Kingdom. Initially, he enrolled at the London School of Economics but eventually studied law at Cambridge University. Lee Kuan Yew served as prime minister for 31 years, from 1959 to 1990. While his government restricted freedoms and maintained strict control over power, he also built excellent public housing, transforming Singapore into one of Asia's wealthiest countries.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 전쟁 후 이관유는 래플스 대학으로 돌아가지 않고 영국에서 ____을 추구했다
det.analysis:
✅ ① higher education: '고등교육'은 원문과 일치, 영국에서 대학 교육을 받은 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② strict control: '엄격한 통제'는 총리 재임 시기의 표현으로 유학 맥락과 불일치
❌ ③ public housing: '공공주택'은 싱가포르에서 건설한 것으로 유학과 무관
❌ ④ medical facility: '의료 시설'은 래플스 대학이 전환된 것으로 추구 대상이 아님
det.tip: pursued higher education in the United Kingdom

det.analysis:
